blocks.text: Chilliwack Rural acreages and estate properties Market Guide

parts.t: This page shows every active MLS® listing for rural acreages and estate properties in Chilliwack, BC. Here is how the local sub-areas compare.
Ryder Lake
Ryder Lake: high-elevation rural acreages and hobby farms above Promontory.
Greendale
Greendale: flat agricultural land and acreages in the ALR west of Sardis.
Yarrow
Yarrow: village-feel rural community with farms, acreages and character homes near Vedder Mountain.
Rosedale
Rosedale: small-town rural living east of Chilliwack with acreages, ranchers and farm parcels.
Columbia Valley
Columbia Valley: secluded valley acreages near Cultus Lake with forest and lake access.
Chilliwack River Valley
Chilliwack River Valley: riverside recreational and residential acreages east along Chilliwack Lake Road.

Most Chilliwack acreages are zoned AL (Agricultural Lands) or RR (Rural Residential), and much of Greendale, Yarrow and Rosedale sits inside the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR), which limits subdivision and secondary dwellings and requires ALC approval for non-farm uses. Confirm well water, septic records and Farm Class status before writing an offer.

Floodplain: parts of Fairfield Island, Greendale, Rosedale, Yarrow and lower Sardis lie in the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, protected by the City's dike network. Ask for the property's flood construction level, lender and insurer requirements, and whether a geotechnical or floodplain covenant is registered on title.

Schools and transit: Chilliwack is served by School District 33 (SD33) — Sardis Secondary, G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary and a range of elementary catchments including Unsworth, Watson and Vedder. Always confirm catchment with SD33 before buying. BC Transit runs Chilliwack routes along Vedder Road, Luckakuck Way and Young Road, and the Fraser Valley Express (Route 66) links Chilliwack to Abbotsford and Carvolth Exchange in Langley.

Where are rural acreages and estate properties for sale in Chilliwack usually located?

Most rural acreages and estate properties in Chilliwack come up in Ryder Lake, Greendale, Yarrow, Rosedale, Columbia Valley and Chilliwack River Valley. Each area has its own mix of age, lot size and price, so I recommend shortlisting two or three neighbourhoods before you book showings.
How often do these Chilliwack acreage listings update?
Listings on this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed several times a day, so new listings, price changes and sold statuses appear quickly.
What should I check on zoning, strata or ALR before buying a Chilliwack acreage?

Most Chilliwack acreages are zoned AL (Agricultural Lands) or RR (Rural Residential), and much of Greendale, Yarrow and Rosedale sits inside the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR), which limits subdivision and secondary dwellings and requires ALC approval for non-farm uses. Confirm well water, septic records and Farm Class status before writing an offer.
Are any Chilliwack rural acreages and estate properties in the floodplain?

Floodplain: parts of Fairfield Island, Greendale, Rosedale, Yarrow and lower Sardis lie in the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, protected by the City's dike network. Ask for the property's flood construction level, lender and insurer requirements, and whether a geotechnical or floodplain covenant is registered on title.
Which schools serve Chilliwack rural acreages and estate properties?

Chilliwack is in School District 33 (SD33). Sardis and the south side feed into Sardis Secondary and G.W. Graham, while the north side feeds Chilliwack Secondary. Catchments change, so confirm with SD33 for a specific address.
Is public transit available near Chilliwack rural acreages and estate properties?

Yes. BC Transit runs local Chilliwack routes along Vedder Road, Luckakuck Way and Young Road, and the Fraser Valley Express connects to Abbotsford and Langley. Rural areas such as Ryder Lake, Greendale and Columbia Valley have little or no bus service.
